editorial:
Imagine being a student at a strict military school where one wrong move gets you in huge trouble. That is exactly where you find Bing Edwards and his two best friends. These guys are the kind of buddies who always have each other's backs, even when they are breaking every single rule in the book. The whole vibe is lighthearted and goofy, focusing on the chaos that happens when Bing reveals a massive secret: he is already married and about to become a dad. You will love watching the three of them scramble to keep this a secret from the officers while trying not to get kicked out of the academy.

The acting is great for its time, and the chemistry between the three leads makes the jokes land perfectly. While the pacing is a bit slower than modern movies, the funny situations keep you interested. It is a sweet, old-school comedy that works best if you just want to relax. It is a perfect pick for a cozy movie night with the family.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the truth about Bing's marriage finally comes out. Instead of getting expelled, the situation is handled with a lot of heart. The school officials realize that Bing is a good man who just wanted to take care of his family. He gets to stay at the academy and keep his dream of graduating alive. It ends on a happy note with his friends supporting him as he starts his life as a father.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school comedies and stories about friendship.
